name: LOFI RADIO
author: ashtonwallen (built on AMB-1 by Charles Vestal)
tagline: Endless lo-fi hip-hop radio. Dusty keys, swung drums, vinyl crackle.
description: LOFI RADIO turns the M-VAVE FM-1 into an endless lo-fi hip-hop station. Every few minutes a new track: a new key and tempo, a jazzy progression on a dusty electric piano, swung boom-bap drums, a round bassline and now and then a muted lead or vibraphone melody, under vinyl crackle and tape wobble. A turntable spins on the screen with each record's label, the track's name and a VU meter. Fourteen styles, from Study to Tokyo Night; four knobs: swing, dust, tempo, mood.
credits: Built on AMB-1 by Charles Vestal, on fm1-base and felucca-bsp, from Felucca by Leo Kuroshita (Hügelton Instruments).
